task.description: Produce the design artefact for REQ-229 (entity record projection and replay), reconciling the table-ownership discrepancy against REQ-228's already-shipped entity_record_latest schema.

result.note: Design doc written to lib/letflow/design/req229-entity-record-projection-replay.md. Table-ownership correction stated explicitly in section 1: entity_record_latest's migration and schema already exist from REQ-228; this design adds no migration/schema changes, only two functions operating on the existing table/event log. Module: Letflow.Entities.Record.Projector, a third sibling under Letflow.Entities.Record.* alongside Validator (REQ-227) and Latest (REQ-228). replay_record/3 resolves the entity type's synthetic instance_id (read-only lookup), reads its full stream via the existing Letflow.EventStore.read/2, filters by payload record_id, folds left-to-right through a 3-event-type table with explicit corruption errors for illegal transitions, mirroring Letflow.Engine.Reconstruction's established fold/replay idiom. rebuild_projection/2 is tenant- or entity-type-scoped, groups each type's event log by record_id, reuses the same fold helper, then delete_all+insert_all against entity_record_latest -- batching strategy is one Repo.transaction/1 PER ENTITY TYPE (not one tenant-wide transaction), bounding lock duration with partial-success recoverability, reasoned out explicitly. Deleted-record representation: a deleted: true flag with field_values retained at last pre-delete value, chosen to match REQ-228's already-shipped delete_record/2 write path exactly. Scope confirmed: no migration/schema, no route/controller, no query DSL. Self-checked: grepped for defmodule/def/schema-do patterns, zero matches; all 4 code fences are @type/@typep/@spec only.
